dedupe_keys.name: trade and transport impact and flow analysis trails

description: Elco Koks and colleagues publish TRAILS, a Python toolkit for trade and transport impact and flow analysis. Zenodo archives a v0.6 code snapshot as Other Open; the linked GitHub source and licence file identify MIT with free access. Its repository contains road-network, origin-destination and flow-model modules, notebooks and example impact results. Modellers can study how disrupted transport links affect routed trade and regional flows. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this toolkit. Coverage depends on supplied road and economic inputs; the repository includes examples, not a globally current freight database. A limitation is that the README offers little setup or interface documentation, so file-level inspection would be needed to run a new country case. Repository source may have changed since the Zenodo snapshot. No code or data archive was downloaded, and no network disruption result was reproduced.
